question: Does the newly located received bibliographic label 萬曆戊申刊本 prove a 1598 early print, a particular 1608 exemplar, or the damaged Xu-An juan45 glyph?

source_1.work: 丁福保、周雲青編《四部總錄·天文編》
source_1.publication: 商務印書館 1956.11, per independent CiNii Books NCID BA79191471
source_1.received_public_extraction: At printed p543 the collated entry 《古今律歷考七十二卷（萬歷戊申刊本）》 is explicitly attributed to 《鄭堂讀書記》; nearby 《適園藏書志》 entry is separately labelled 明刊本 and says its front matter has 萬曆戊申 prefaces.

previous_1994_conflict.statement: Large 《中國古籍善本書目·子部2》 web extraction separately appears as 萬曆二十六年/張崇禎/王國楨; the 1994 original target row remains without native visual confirmation. Calendar year 萬曆二十六 = 1598, while 戊申 in Wanli chronology = 1608. These cannot be silently equated, and one later catalogue does not disprove the possibility of another impression.

adjudication.positive: A newly bounded 1956 received bibliography independently reports a 1608-labelled work entry and a separate 1608-preface report; official NCL catalog directly identifies a specific 1608 Sun Wei holding distinct from a Xu-An 1600 holding.
